latestVersion.changelog:
Candy AI 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Turn a 30-second selfie video into a 1080p AI companion video simply by uploading and describing the result you want.
- Interactive session management: connects to backend API, acquires or uses a token, and establishes a secure session automatically.
- Supports video, image, and audio uploads; generates, edits, and exports companion character videos in about 1–2 minutes.
- Simple command-based workflow for exports, credit checks, timeline previews, and uploading files.
- All actions run on cloud GPUs and return downloadable links—no local setup required.
- Built-in error handling and tips for smooth user experience.
